joint_reference.lineage: Authenticated historical joint treatment replay; not contemporaneously retrained.

relation_only.interpretation: Met the predeclared 222/222-per-seed development criterion and matched the historical joint reference on these repeated development queries.

random_initialization_plus_adaptation.interpretation: Did not meet the predeclared 222/222-per-seed criterion. Preserve all four false negatives; do not call this arm a full match.

outcome.planned_gate: The strict 222/222-per-seed criterion is met by joint-reference and relation-only, but not by random. The primary joint-reference versus relation-only development comparison is tied; the three-arm all-match criterion is not met.

audit_and_numerical_review.audit_scope: Independent reconstruction of selected sets, exactness, macro F1, FP/FN and group metrics from saved scores; checkpoint identity/hash/shape/finiteness/optimizer-state inspection. It does not independently replay the neural model or training and is not a separate-author code review.
audit_and_numerical_review.cpu_replay_scope: Post-fit query-side equation verification only; no training or threshold change.
audit_and_numerical_review.summary_audit_pending_field: summary.json retains audit_pending=true as the runner-time snapshot; the separate hash-linked audit.json is complete and passed.

scientific_interpretation.supported: For this fixed 1025-entity transductive catalog and the same historically guided 222 development queries, the relation-only training recipe matched the historical joint reference at 222/222 for all three seeds. Random-initialization plus the same adaptation scored 662/666 across the repeated query-seed runs, with four false negatives and no false positives.
scientific_interpretation.comparison_boundary: Relation-only removes both transformer-dependent objectives and their gradients; it does not isolate attention. Update and query exposure are matched, not FLOPs, wall time, or effective optimizer steps. The joint reference is historical rather than contemporaneously retrained.
not_supported: 666 independent observations or a population-level significance claim
Transformer or attention necessity, or an attention-only causal effect
Protected-test parity; the protected 191 remain closed
Serving latency/energy advantage or replacement of the serving stack
Model promotion or a claim that learned checkpoints are archived
development_limitations: The same 222 development queries are repeated for all three seeds; totals of 666 are descriptive only.
Development outcomes were guided by prior research and the catalog is transductive.
The plan records known symmetric pair overlap across query partitions.
Training exactness is reported by the execution artifact and was not independently replayed by this audit.

source_review_followups.detail: The evaluation wrapper receives rows containing expected_set_ids and tensors() validates/materializes a label tensor before scoring, then discards it. Prompt IDs drive scores and expected labels drive post-score metrics; no label-value path into scores was observed. Keep the paper wording precise: prediction uses prompts only, while the evaluator receives labels for post-score metrics.

The plan lists original-initialization equivalence and no-decoder-call synthetic gates that are not explicit assertions in the reviewed test file. The pinned factory and compact-model source path support these properties by inspection; describe them as source-level evidence unless separate test receipts are added.
publication-review-v1.json was written before outcomes completed and says the random arm was still running. It is retained unchanged and is superseded for outcome status by this final review.

publication_status.next_owner: Primary task to complete its report and immutable ready handoff; publication remains unauthorized until that handoff is supplied.

final_assessment: The result supports descriptive parity of relation-only versus the historical joint reference on the fixed development set, while the random arm misses the strict all-seed exactness criterion by four false negatives. No blocking inconsistency was found in the sealed audit chain or CPU score replay. Preserve the failed random-arm gate and the limited, repeated-development interpretation.
